scenarios.given: published edition references an eligible source
scenarios.then: public read uses current source content and recomputes source fence

scenarios.given: source is private, protected, unlisted, deleted, unpublished, rootless, or has no slug
scenarios.then: edition is hidden without a placeholder or source id
slug is accepted by the shared validator
request is rejected; the historical 263-character read limit is not used

scenarios.given: public series and every published source are eligible
scenarios.when: series and source allow_search_indexing are true
scenarios.then: ReportIndexability is true and the series/visible editions may enter discovery

scenarios.given: series or any source lacks explicit opt-in
scenarios.then: metadata may be returned but robots is noindex and discovery excludes it
slug remains readable to a knower but always noindex and undiscoverable

scenarios.given: a report is created or source changes
scenarios.when: Search, Social Feed, or dynamic OG surfaces are inspected
scenarios.then: no Search type, feed item kind, or dynamic OG operation is emitted

scenarios.when: caller attempts to attach a different source
scenarios.then: mutation is rejected; withdraw old edition and create a new one
